subject: release-tooling/recovery-state-recognition
statement: Recovery transformations must recognize BEFORE, AFTER, and known PARTIAL semantic states. Exact whole-block textual matching is not a durable recovery contract; valid partial progress must be preserved and resumed.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Preserve reusable R7 declarative-update, recovery, and automatic-update lessons after successful 0.16.2 dogfood.
